messages.author: bbb9357156c132fe
messages.subject: Alloc fail in inla.qsample
parts:
Hi all,

I got the following error, which traces back to a qsample.  Any idea what's going on? I'm on the latest testing version.

GMRFLib version 3.0-0-snapshot, has recived error no [1]
Reason    : Alloc failed
Function  : GMRFLib_init_problem
File      : problem-setup.c
Line      : 175
RCSId     : file: problem-setup.c  hgid: a142ee86dfd3  date: Mon Feb 19 07:11:53 2018 +0300

Error in file(rng.file, "rb") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In rexp(1, lambda_sigma) : NAs produced
2: In rgamma(1, shape = 1, rate = lambda_range) : NAs produced
3: In file(rng.file, "rb") :
 

The error traces back to the inla.qsample call.  The Q matrix isn't singular (Matrix::chol works fine).

I've attached the data and code that makes it fail.  

Best wishes

dan
